scope: Six isolated negative fixture groups for the planning package validator
method: Each mutation ran against a temporary package copy with a fresh manifest. Original package files were not mutated by fixtures.

cases.mutation: Add an invented active Claude settings key
Replace a source-field identity while retaining 196 unique rows
errors: Mapping identities differ from actual pinned source inventory

cases.mutation: Duplicate an otherwise valid manifest entry
errors: Manifest has duplicate entries or incorrect count

cases.mutation: Add a directory-only ZIP member containing parent traversal
Request an in-package report write during archive verification
Add parent traversal and absolute manifest paths in separate temporary copies
cases.instrumentation: Path methods are spied for the synthetic target and raise before access

variants.target: Synthetic file outside the temporary package
Synthetic file outside the temporary package

limitations: This is regression evidence for the six listed cases, not exhaustive validator security testing.
Unrelated missing final package reports did not determine the targeted assertions.
No product runtime, live Claude or Codex client, MCP server, or game was invoked.
